text.p: The Nigerian government has expanded the group of experts planning the country's economic future, to 194 from 172, by adding a group dedicated to science and technology.

"Additional people had to be added because we found that we need their invaluable contributions," Ibrahim Ida, secretary of the "Vision 2010" committee, told journalists in the capital Abuja on Friday.
The overall team includes managing directors of the multinational oil companies working in Nigeria as well as government officials, bankers, businessmen and traditional chiefs.
The second session of the committee, which was told by military ruler General Sani Abacha to deliver its plan by September, began on Thursday and will end on Saturday.
